_readme: S663 SkyLark, 2026-11-16. Sam's ruling d-both-versions-by-catalog-year-sam-2026-11-15: a plain transfer degree and its 2.0 each keep a record from their own catalog year. Riverside City's four plain siblings (30578, 32692, 32745, 33829) read from their 2.0's page in catalog 124 (2026-2027). The prior-catalog read needs the 2025-2026 catalog's id and its alias view. This read asks the host's own catalog list, as cq_catalog_from_list reads it, and the active-catalogs page. Two loads, no model call.
